mentions.heading: The semiconductor industry is highly cyclical.
mentions.detail: Semiconductor capacity cycles cause overcapacity, high inventory, under-utilization and accelerated ASP erosion
mentions.quote: These downturns have been characterized by diminishing demand for end-user products, high inventory levels, under-utilization of manufacturing capacity and accelerated erosion of average selling prices.

mentions.heading: Significantly increased volatility and instability and unfavorable economic conditions may adversely affect our business.
mentions.detail: 2020 automotive demand collapse from pandemic shutdowns; 2020-2022 rebound unmet; softening demand 2023-2025 from macro and geopolitics
mentions.quote: In the first half of 2020, demand in the automotive market steeply declined as a result of manufacturing shutdowns by automotive customers due to the coronavirus pandemic, resulting in an unforeseen negative impact to our results of operations.
